spec.name: SENSOR MOUNT PLATE
notes: Material 6061-T6 aluminum, qty 25, Rev A.
General tolerance ±0.1 mm, angles ±0.5° unless otherwise specified.
Surface finish Ra 3.2 µm on all machined surfaces.
Break all sharp edges 0.2-0.4 x 45°, deburr.
Top face is the A-surface: clean, no marking, stamping, or clamp marks on top.
Finished thickness 20; outside 120 x 80 with R8 corners.
Pocket 64 x 36, R6 inside corners, 8 deep, centered on the part; Ø6 or smaller cutter required for R6 corners.
4X Ø6.6 thru on a 100 x 60 pattern, centered (M6 clearance), z_top 0 to z_bottom -20.
2X Ø8 thru from pocket floor at X ±20, Y 0: z_top -8 to z_bottom -20.
Slot 40 x 8 full R4, 4 deep, centerline 30 below part center (Y -30), centered in X; Ø8 or smaller cutter.
Profile cuts through the full thickness in one setup. Use tabs, a sacrificial spoilboard, or oversize stock with a hold-down method, and do not mark the top face.
Estimated part weight 0.45 kg.
questions_for_customer: Slot '40 X 8': is 40 the overall length (end to end) or the center-to-center distance of the R4 ends? We assumed 40 overall.
The pocket and slot have no X/Y location dimensions. We assumed both are centered on the part in X, and that the pocket is centered in Y. Please confirm.

The bottom face and its edges need Ra 3.2 and an edge break. Is a second setup or flip operation allowed to face the bottom and deburr the bottom edges, or should we use stock already at 20 mm thickness?
Is there any tighter positional tolerance needed on the Ø6.6 and Ø8 holes, or is ±0.1 acceptable for the sensor interface?
